_comment: Frame time is a property of a machine, not of the build: an M4's ms/frame means nothing on a CI runner's software renderer, so there is no single global number here, only one block per machine_tag (see bench.c's bench_finish for how the tag is built and prof.h for what frame_ms_median is a median of). A machine_tag that is not a key below has no baseline yet, and tools/bench_check.py treats that as 'nothing to compare against' rather than a pass or a fail on its own -- pass --allow-missing-baseline to let a run with no baseline through anyway (CI does this today). The rule going forward: the same commit that adds or changes a CI job's bench step must also add that runner's tag here, learned from that job's own first green run, so the tolerance check actually gates something instead of quietly no-op'ing forever.
